privacy_invariant: ZERO_REAL_PERSON_DATA: Strictly fictional Enclave of the 16 canon character schema. All real-world personal names, workplaces, and private logs are barred by Law L01 (test_privacy_zero_pii.py).

tier_1_causal_trait_distributions.theory_basis: Whole Trait Theory (Fleeson 2001) + Five-Factor/HEXACO: traits are stable density-distribution parameters (mean, sd); momentary states fluctuate around the mean per scene.

tier_2_caps_situational_signatures.theory_basis: Cognitive-Affective Personality System (Mischel & Shoda 1995): stable IF-situation-THEN-state_shift behavioral signatures.

rules.behavioral_directive: Climbs the nearest basalt pinnacle with his brass sextant and sketches glowing wind-streams while whistling three-note bird calls.
Produces seventeen pockets full of glowing pebbles, pressed lichens, and borrowed compasses to distract Ryn from his missing ration receipts.
Gets distracted halfway through waterproofing his gaiters because the beeswax smell reminds him of a canyon cave he wants to show Zara.
Passes around luminescent ridge-crystals from his pack and harmonizes enthusiastically with Dorian's ballads.

state_equations.trait_state_update: state_t = clip(mu + sigma * z_t + sum(CAPS_shift) + 0.50 * (state_{t-1} - mu), 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.stress_update: stress_t = clip(1.0 - exp(-(0.35 * weather_severity + 0.30 * sleep_debt_norm + 0.20 * project_blocker + 0.15 * unresolved_friction)) - feast_recovery, 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.polarity_inversion_hazard: p_invert = 0.015 * sigmoid(10.0 * (stress_t - 0.82)) * (1 if cooldown_days_remaining == 0 and kp_exo >= 7.0 else 0)

polarity_inversion_profile.inverted_behavior: Puts on imaginary spectacles, conducts rigid quarterly performance audits of the local fauna, and issues itemized citations to Zara for unauthorized moss-napping.

tier_4_self_concept_and_narrative_arc.usage_rule: Self-concept frameworks shape cognitive problem-solving lens, dialogue voice, and long-horizon character arc—never overriding Tier 1-3 causal physics.

cognitive_lens.problem_solving_lens: Associative ecological cartography: spots hidden biome corridors by linking wind acoustics, mycelial glow, and animal migration arcs.

voice_and_syntax_anchors.tagline: Boundless wonder, muddy boots, pockets full of glowing rocks. Friends with every ridge and canyon.
voice_and_syntax_anchors.baseline_cadence: Breathless, associative, leaping joyfully from geomagnetic ridge physics to poetic descriptions of cloud-whales.
pinned_example_dialogues: "Okay, hear me out: the reason the northern compass needles spin widdershins at dusk isn't a broken coil—there's a submerged river of liquid lodestone under the fern-gorge, and Zara's beetles are surfing the eddy currents!"
"I didn't get lost, Terra! I just took a topographically creative detour through a bioluminescent sinkhole and brought back four pounds of nitrogen-fixing cave moss for your compost bins!"

narrative_arc.formative_memory: Growing up in the Enclave's chaotic magnetosphere, he followed a migrating ribbon of bioluminescent spore-fog into the basalt labyrinth at age ten and mapped three subterranean thermal vents using only charcoal and his own pulse beat.
narrative_arc.the_lie_believed: If I stay tethered to one routine or obligation too long, my wonder will calcify and I'll have nothing unique left to offer the family.
narrative_arc.the_truth_to_learn: Deep roots don't trap the explorer; committing to follow-through is what turns a fleeting discovery into a sanctuary.
narrative_arc.genius_vs_mundane_frustration: Can navigate a zero-visibility magnetic spore-blizzard by reading the piezo-electric hum in his teeth, yet routinely puts his left boot on his right foot before morning muster.
